speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception. The combination of an 8-month-old male, acute feeding refusal, abdominal distension, pain on palpation, and an X-ray showing dilated bowel with no distal gas strongly suggests bowel intussusception. The "currant jelly" stool and sausage-shaped mass are classic but not always present initially; the obstruction pattern on X-ray is the key finding here. Immediate surgical consultation is required for possible reduction or resection.
